specializations.description: Subclass specializations for each calling, chosen at level 3 (Tier 2)

dedication.name: Bladedancer
dedication.description: Masters of agile combat who blend martial prowess with graceful movement. They favor finesse weapons and high mobility.
dedication.flavorText: You have dedicated yourself to the art of the blade dance, a fighting style that emphasizes speed, precision, and grace over brute force.
dedication.playstyle: Mobile skirmisher with high AC and precision strikes

3.name: Unarmored Defense
3.description: While not wearing armor, your AC = 10 + DEX + WIS

7.name: Evasion
7.description: DEX saves: success = no damage, fail = half damage

10.name: Dance of Ten Thousand Cuts
10.description: Extra attack when you take the Attack action, +2 AC without heavy armor

dedication.name: Juggernaut
dedication.description: Unstoppable tanks who wade into battle in heavy armor. They specialize in protection, control, and outlasting their foes.
dedication.flavorText: You have become an immovable object, a wall of steel that protects your allies and crushes your enemies.
dedication.playstyle: Tanky defender with area control and durability

3.name: Heavy Armor Master
3.description: Physical damage reduced by 3 when wearing heavy armor

7.name: Indomitable
7.description: Reroll a failed saving throw once per long rest

10.name: Unstoppable
10.description: Advantage on STR checks/saves, can't be knocked prone while conscious

dedication.name: Ascetic
dedication.description: Monk traditions focused on unarmed combat, spiritual discipline, and ki mastery.
dedication.flavorText: You have embraced the ascetic path, honing your body and mind into perfect harmony through rigorous discipline.
dedication.playstyle: Unarmed striker with mobility and ki abilities

3.name: Martial Arts
3.description: Unarmed strikes use d6 (d8 at 5th, d10 at 10th), can use DEX for unarmed strikes

7.name: Stunning Strike
7.description: Spend 1 ki to force CON save or stun until your next turn

10.name: Perfect Self
10.description: Regain 4 ki points at start of turn if you have 0, unarmed strikes count as magical
